description:
Plan: ../recursive-denotations-proposal.html. Stack of PRs on main: PR1 reproducers+signal, PR2 fz-tfn.62 narrow, PR3 fz-kdt.48, PR4 fz-kdt.177 kernel, PR5 fz-kdt.177 semantics.

PR3. As built on fz-kdt.48/one-ty-per-denotation at 3cf777603 (reviewed in three cold passes): types/axis.rs is the one absorber for the tuple, list, resource and map axes at Types::intern, and TyCanon runs the same function on the descriptors it synthesizes (and on the callable axis, replacing canon's saturate/drop_subsumed/visit_order). Each axis is one AxisView (install, clause_covers, structural coverage rule, optional AxisTop). Coverage is tiered: single-sibling containment through memoized Types::is_subtype, then the axis's structural rule (tuples/maps positionwise necessary condition over all same-arity/same-tag siblings; lists exact by shape; resources exact under the kernel = one sibling contains it alone, because emptiness::resource_clause_empty requires a single negative to swallow the payload), then the exact union question over descriptors (never mints). Only lists and resources have a top to reach, written as the widest single sig ([any], resource(any)); tuples and maps never saturate. A contentless clause is settled before the walk. Deleted: absorb_subsumed_tuple_clauses, absorb_subsumed_list_clauses, absorb_subsumed_clauses, dnf::tuple_clause_subsumed, dnf::list_clause_subsumed, per-axis exact dedupe, canon's saturate/drop_subsumed/visit_order. Also in this commit: storage clause order is a pure function of the descriptor (order.rs cmp_callable in Storage mode by FnId only; Activation keeps origin order) so TypeInterner::lookup is asked first in intern (95% of intern calls are index hits; misses unchanged). Census unchanged 134 / 17.

NOT in this ticket, by decision after the first review: the callable axis is excluded from intern's absorber (an arrow carries a declared signature and a closure's capture layout beside its denotation; saturating (int) -> any or absorbing closure[f]([mailbox]) into closure[f]([any]) would erase them). The funcs-axis absorption/saturation at intern lands with fz-kdt.48.7 once callable identity is one Ty per value.

comments.text: Reworked absorber measured on fz-kdt.48/one-ty-per-denotation at 2cb74c6bf (2026-09-16), counts authoritative, three inputs = enum_take_drop_split / range_map_converges / json_roundtrip: exact union questions 0 / 0 / 291 (all 291 involve a clause or sibling with a negative factor, which the structural rules do not read; positionwise gate never wrong); saturation questions 0 / 0 / 0; memoized subtype questions 34,673 / 4,810 / 229,590 vs parent addeaaa95 36,595 / 4,896 / 235,488; intern calls and misses unchanged; census 134 / 17. Wall-clock corroborative: json_roundtrip 4.2-4.6 s vs 5.5 s at the parent. Scope as built: tuple, list, resource, map axes; callable axis excluded (stated once, types/axis.rs module doc); tuples and maps never saturate (unbounded arity / struct tags); top written as the widest single sig, never Conj::top().

title: One absorber with saturation on every non-callable axis, at intern
